name: Plex Media Server
subtitle: Stream your movies, shows and music
description:
Runs Plex Media Server so you can stream your own movies, TV shows, music and photos to Plex apps on phones, TVs and computers.

Upload media to the Movies, TV Shows, Music and Photos folders here, then add them as libraries in Plex. Show Media Folder Paths gives the exact locations.

Setting up a server with no screen? Get a claim token at plex.tv/claim, paste it into Settings, and run Link to Plex Account.

If Plex already starts on its own (at login, or as a Linux service), turn that off first so only EasyServer runs it.

requires.label: Plex Media Server

win32.path: C:/Program Files/Plex/Plex Media Server/Plex Media Server.exe
C:/Program Files (x86)/Plex/Plex Media Server/Plex Media Server.exe

linux: command -v apt-get >/dev/null || { echo "Download Plex from plex.tv/media-server-downloads"; exit 1; }; curl -fsSL https://downloads.plex.tv/plex-keys/PlexSign.key | sudo -n gpg --dearmor --yes -o /usr/share/keyrings/plex.gpg && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/plex.gpg] https://downloads.plex.tv/repo/deb public main" | sudo -n tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/plexmediaserver.list >/dev/null && sudo -n apt-get update && sudo -n apt-get install -y plexmediaserver && sudo -n systemctl disable --now plexmediaserver

requires.hint: Install Plex Media Server from plex.tv/media-server-downloads.
